_readme: Append-only log of weekly 6-MONTH SWING cohorts. Each cohort is an independent Rs 1,00,000 paper portfolio, decided once (momentum + dated-catalyst screen, swing_screen.py) and priced off the prior Friday's close, then left FROZEN for its own 6-month horizon with per-holding -16% hard stops -- same append-only, never-rebalanced pattern as paper-trading/cohorts.json's standard/concentrated series, just for the swing methodology. SEPARATE from paper-trading/cohorts.json (fundamentals-driven) and paper-trading/live-recommendation/portfolio.json (continuously rebalanced). NEVER edit an existing cohort's holdings/entry_price/shares/cash after creation. New cohorts are appended by the paper-trading-weekly scheduled task every Monday. Mark-to-market values live in TRACKER.md (regenerated) and history.json, not here.

cohorts.note: Started off-cycle on a Thursday (2026-09-03) to begin tracking immediately, rather than waiting for the next Monday. Originally run as a single ongoing book (portfolio-v1.json, monthly re-screen); migrated byte-for-byte into this cohort-based format on 2026-09-11 when the swing book switched to a weekly append-only cohort series like the standard/concentrated series. Continues under its original rules and 2027-03-03 horizon -- migration changed nothing about its holdings, prices, or dates.
cohorts.benchmark: Nifty Smallcap 250 (primary tracked; Nifty Microcap 250 TRI / BSE Smallcap TRI as originally specified in SWING_6M_PORTFOLIO.md but not reliably fetchable)

rules.thesis_break_exit: guidance cut, quarterly miss vs the tracked catalyst, or close below the rising 30W EMA for two consecutive weekly closes -> exit next session
rules.trim_rule: on catalyst realisation, if no new 20-day high within ~3 weeks of the event, cut the position by half

cohorts.source: Hand-curated from swing_screen.py's momentum+catalyst scores, 2026-09-03. Full reasoning: SWING_6M_PORTFOLIO.md.

holdings.name: Electronics Mart India
holdings.catalyst: Q2 FY27 results ~early Nov 2026; Dec-quarter (Q3 FY27) is the seasonal peak and first quarter carrying the 4-5% price hikes
holdings.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT +458% after two years of margin compression; consumer-durables retailer with operating leverage turning, near 52-week high, rising 30W and 10W EMAs. Largest weight because it is the most liquid name here.

holdings.name: Senores Pharmaceuticals
holdings.catalyst: Rolling ANDA approvals + Q2 FY27 results ~Nov 2026
holdings.thesis: Consistent ANDA-approval compounder that has been beating its own aggressive guidance; +37% over 3 months, extension healthy (not blown off), rising EMAs.

holdings.name: Unimech Aerospace
holdings.thesis: Q1 revenue +71%, ROE 22.6% / ROCE 21.4%, low debt; clean momentum (3m +34%) with quality behind it.

holdings.name: Yash Highvoltage
holdings.catalyst: Vadodara greenfield commissioning + trial production H1 FY27; first commercial RIP output from October 2026; H1 FY27 print ~Nov 2026 on the Rs 360-400 Cr FY27 invoicing guide
holdings.thesis: Bushing-shortage play with a dated, near-term capacity catalyst; expectation-gap window 6 months, pending. Also held in the frozen weekly cohorts (overlap accepted).

holdings.name: Vikram Thermo
holdings.thesis: Highest raw swing score (already-strong fundamentals reinforced by Q1 FY27 margin expansion against rising input costs). Weight capped at 12% despite the score because it is BSE-only, thin, and the most extended name in the book (+35% vs 30W EMA); stop kept tight.

holdings.name: Apcotex Industries
holdings.catalyst: Anti-dumping duty decision + Q2 FY27 results ~Oct 2026
holdings.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 (revenue +40%, PAT +311%) on an anti-dumping filing plus capacity utilisation; synthetic-rubber / specialty-emulsions maker, extension healthy.

holdings.name: L. T. Elevators
holdings.catalyst: DYPC acquisition close by ~30 Sep 2026; H1 FY27 result ~Nov 2026 showing the growth run-rate WITH operating cash flow tracking profit
holdings.thesis: SME lift + parking maker doubling revenue with a 3-month dated catalyst window. Weight capped at 10% because the conviction score fell 61->47 on a management-quality flag, and it is SME-liquidity.

holdings.name: Neetu Yoshi
holdings.catalyst: Haridwar capacity doubling commissioning Sep 2026; H1 FY27 results ~Nov 2026 toward the Rs 210-220 Cr FY27 guide with OPM >25%
holdings.thesis: SME railway Class-A foundry, ROCE ~32%, near 52-week high. Smallest weight (8%) for SME liquidity; tight stop.

excluded_notable.name: Macpower CNC Machines
excluded_notable.reason: Vertical chase: +105% over 3 months and +43% above its 30W EMA. Highest fundamental tier here, but the risk/reward on a FRESH 6-month entry is poor and it is already held in all three frozen weekly cohorts.

excluded_notable.name: Venus Remedies
excluded_notable.reason: Momentum stalled (3m +9%, 10W EMA slope ~flat) and its catalyst window is 12 months and not dated. Fails the 6-month framework on both momentum and catalyst timing. Held elsewhere for the long thesis.

excluded_notable.name: Dynamic Cables / Surya Roshni / HBL Engineering / Transrail Lighting / CSB Bank
excluded_notable.reason: Below a falling 30W EMA and negative 3-month return -- excluded by the trend filter despite good businesses / real order books. Revisit if they reclaim a rising EMA before a review date.

excluded_notable.name: SML Isuzu / Marine Electricals / Vivid Electromech
excluded_notable.reason: No usable Yahoo price history -> cannot be priced or tracked systematically. Ineligible until a data source exists.

cohorts.benchmark: Nifty Smallcap 250 (primary tracked; Nifty Microcap 250 TRI / BSE Smallcap TRI as originally specified in SWING_6M_PORTFOLIO.md but not reliably fetchable)

rules.thesis_break_exit: guidance cut, quarterly miss vs the tracked catalyst, or close below the rising 30W EMA for two consecutive weekly closes -> exit next session
rules.trim_rule: on catalyst realisation, if no new 20-day high within ~3 weeks of the event, cut the position by half

cohorts.source: Hand-curated from swing_screen.py's momentum+catalyst scores, 2026-09-21. 8 names from a screen of ~25 candidates (5 dropped on missing Yahoo price history: Vivid Electromech, SML Isuzu, Unimech Aerospace, Marine Electricals, Bondada Engineering). Neetu Yoshi (SCORE 79.8) excluded as a vertical chase: +48.6% above its 30W EMA, over the ~40-45% threshold, despite a real Sep-2026 capacity-doubling catalyst -- revisit on a pullback. Weights tiered by SCORE, capped at 16% (single-name) and 10% (SME/thin-liquidity, applied to L. T. Elevators and Yash Highvoltage per the 2026-09-16 is_sme_emerge tagging). Full reasoning: SWING_6M_PORTFOLIO.md.

holdings.name: Macpower CNC Machines
holdings.catalyst: Q2 FY27 results ~Oct-Nov 2026; guided FY27 capex-cycle order inflow continuing
holdings.thesis: 4 straight quarters of accelerating growth (Q1 FY27 revenue +56%), CNC-machine capex-cycle beneficiary. Excluded from the inaugural cohort as a vertical chase at +43% above its 30W EMA; extension has since eased to +35.7% (3m return also cooled from +105% to +65.6%) while the earnings trajectory stayed intact, so the original objection no longer holds. Already a holding in the standard and concentrated frozen books too -- accepted here given the strength of the setup, not treated as a diversification breach.

holdings.name: Electronics Mart India
holdings.catalyst: Q2 FY27 results ~early Nov 2026; Dec-quarter (Q3 FY27) is the seasonal peak and first quarter carrying the 4-5% price hikes
holdings.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT +458% after two years of margin compression; consumer-durables retailer with operating leverage turning, near 52-week high, rising 30W and 10W EMAs. Same name/thesis as the inaugural cohort's largest holding -- momentum and catalyst both still intact one cycle later.

holdings.name: L. T. Elevators
holdings.catalyst: DYPC acquisition close ~30 Sep 2026; H1 FY27 result ~Nov 2026 showing the growth run-rate with operating cash flow tracking profit
holdings.thesis: SME-listed elevator + automated-parking maker roughly doubling revenue on a ~10%+ sector tailwind; the DYPC close is a hard near-term date within days of this cohort's decision. SME/Emerge-listed (per 2026-09-16 tagging) -- capped at the 10% SME/thin-liquidity ceiling rather than its raw score-implied weight.

holdings.name: Vikram Thermo
holdings.thesis: Agro/pharma intermediates maker; Q1 FY27 showed real margin expansion on top of steady revenue growth (3m +35.3%). Extension (+36.9%) is below the ~40-45% vertical-chase threshold.

holdings.name: Aimtron Electronics
holdings.catalyst: Q2 FY27 results ~Oct-Nov 2026; continued EMS order-book scale-up
holdings.thesis: New this cycle. EMS (China+1) play with a verified FY26 revenue ~2x beat and PAT +77%; moderate extension (+27.0%) gives more room than most names on this screen. No prior-cohort overlap.

holdings.name: Sambhv Steel Tubes
holdings.catalyst: Q2 FY27 results ~Oct-Nov 2026; continuing quality-growth run-rate
holdings.thesis: New this cycle. Two consecutive quarters of accelerating, quality (not one-off) growth; extension +29.5% is moderate, 10W EMA slope still rising (+6.1). No prior-cohort overlap.

holdings.name: Yash Highvoltage
holdings.catalyst: Vadodara greenfield commissioning + trial production H1 FY27; first commercial RIP output from October 2026
holdings.thesis: Same dated catalyst carried from the inaugural cohort -- the October RIP commissioning is now imminent, within weeks of this cohort's decision date. SME-listed (BSE) -- capped at the 10% SME/thin-liquidity ceiling. Also a holding in the standard/concentrated books; accepted for the same reason as Macpower.

holdings.name: Apcotex Industries
holdings.catalyst: Anti-dumping duty decision + Q2 FY27 results ~Oct 2026
holdings.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 (revenue +40%, PAT +311%) specialty-rubber/latex maker; lowest score here but by far the least extended (+15.5% vs 30W EMA) of the shortlist, giving the most room to a dated catalyst (the anti-dumping ruling) that could re-rate it further. Sized smallest given the weaker relative momentum (3m +12.2% vs peers' 30-65%).

excluded_notable.name: Neetu Yoshi
excluded_notable.reason: Vertical chase: +48.6% above its 30W EMA (over the ~40-45% threshold) despite a real Sep-2026 Haridwar capacity-doubling catalyst. Revisit on a pullback toward the EMA.

excluded_notable.name: Senores Pharmaceuticals / Ujjivan SFB / Thyrocare / Stylam Industries / Venus Remedies
excluded_notable.reason: Lower SCORE (27.9-47.4) than the 8 selected names on this screen -- weaker momentum or catalyst timing relative to the shortlist; not excluded on any hard rule.

excluded_notable.name: HBL Engineering / CSB Bank / Dynamic Cables / Surya Roshni / Transrail Lighting
excluded_notable.reason: SCORE 0-22.4 -- flat or negative 3-month momentum / below a flat-to-falling 30W EMA, failing the trend filter this cycle despite real order-book or earnings stories.

excluded_notable.name: Vivid Electromech / SML Isuzu / Unimech Aerospace / Marine Electricals / Bondada Engineering
excluded_notable.reason: No usable Yahoo price history (404) -- cannot be priced or tracked systematically. Ineligible until a data source exists.
